title: The Re-added Window
prompt:
**Scenario.** Code computes, for every window of size k, the window's sum by looping k elements: O(nk) with n = 200000, k = 1000. What is the fix?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Rewrite the inner loop in assembly

**B)** Sliding window: maintain a running sum, add the entering element, subtract the leaving one — O(n)

**C)** Sort the array first

**D)** Use a segment tree over the array

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: The named waste is re-adding overlapping elements; the running-sum deletion removes it. A segment tree would also work (O(n log n)) but is heavier than the O(n) deletion.
